content:
It's time to take a look at the best new cases for iPhone 18 Pro. Apple has launched a whole new lineup of silicone and TechWoven styles with matching color treatments, alongside some of our longtime favorite third-party options. There's everything from a new burgundy colorway with a built-in kickstand to ultra-grippy customizable options and some of the best leather choices from brands like Nomad and Burton Goods. We also have some of the most affordable options, starting at $14 from budget brands like Spigen.

Best iPhone 18 Pro Cases

Updated 9/27: This article has been updated with some additional exclusive promo codes for 9to5 readers.

Apple

Featured Partner: ESR

ESR's brand new lineup of iPhone 18 Pro cases and accessories is now here with premium matching colors, patented tech, and more. The star of the new gear is the latest Atelier Vegan Leather Magnetic Case with a built-in zinc alloy Flex Stand, camera plateau protection, 3x military-grade protection, and a "soft, flexible feel that's comfortable to hold." Like its other accessory lineups, the new Atelier comes in four matching colorways to perfectly match the new burgundy, glacial, black, and silver iPhone 18 Pro models.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather Magnetic Case with Flex Stand $42 (Reg. $46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector $30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock Magnetic Case $21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo Magnetic Wallet Stand (Grip) $46 (Reg. $50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

When it comes to leather cases, Nomad is one of the best in the business, and all of its most popular models are now ready for iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. There's also a new Rugged Case lineup this year, each color featuring topographical maps of the Baja Peninsula:

  • Rugged Case $70
  • Colors: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather $69
  • Colors: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back $59
  • Colors: Burgundy, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case $55
  • Colors: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Gray
  • Modern Leather Case $69 – $89
  • Traditional Leather Case $79 – $99
  • Rugged Leather Case $79
  • Colors: Rustic Brown

Featured Partner: Dbrand

Dbrand is ready to go with its time-tested Grip case for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. Beyond being one of the cleanest-looking cases on the market with an ultra-grippy texture, it's once again compatible with a massive library of skin wraps to customize the look, and you can score a nice discount on a matching Prism screen protector as well.

  • Dbrand Grip Case for iPhone 18 Pro/Max $55 Customizable case, shock-absorbing protection, super grippy, excellent button feel
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 for iPhone 18 Pro/Max 2-pack $35 ($5 off with case purchase) Foolproof installation, auto-alignment, zero dust

Dbrand is also rolling out its new MNML branded cases this year, starting at $39 with a super clean design, even lower pricing, MagSafe support, and that crisp button feel we've always loved.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case $39 Black, Navy, Tan, Burgundy

****Note: SANDMARC gear traditionally only goes on sale once a year… unless you use the exclusive promo code above.

Bluebonnet

Bluebonnet is a small Texas-based shop that crafts some of the nicest full-grain leather cases around with an edge-to-edge design — no plastic whatsoever — alongside copper-plated metal buttons. We also have an exclusive 20% off the new iPhone 18 Pro models for 9to5 readers:

  • Minimalist Full-Grain Leather iPhone 18 Pro MagSafe Case $63 (Reg. $79) with promo code 9to5 at checkout

Luriax

  • The Signature Suede-like for iPhone 18 Pro $107 (Reg. $120) with promo code 9TO5
  • The Modern Suede-like for iPhone 18 Pro $62 (Reg. $69)

Arc

  • Matte Black – $69.99

  • Matte Deep Red – $119.99

  • iPhone 18 Series All-Leather Case $59
  • Colors: Black, Basalt, Obsidian Green, Tan, Terracotta
  • iPhone 18 Series Modular Case $59
  • Detachable magnetic backplate lets you switch between two modes. With backplate attached: full-grain leather case, slim and MagSafe compatible

Burton Goods

Alto Collective – Laser Engraved Wood

  • Alto Laser Engraved Wood iPhone 18 Pro Cases from $33 (10% off) with promo code 9TO5MAC at checkout Engraved Series Retro Inlay Series Custom image upload

UAG

UAG also has a lineup of iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max cases, including its usual rugged offerings with chunky corner protection, grippy bezels, and plenty of drop-focused design. If you want a more aggressive look and everyday protection, UAG's lineup is worth a look.

  • UAG Mouve $65 for iPhone Duo
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case $80 for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max
  • UAG Civilian Anti-Slip Case from $60
  • And more…

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max Cases

If you're looking to outfit your new iPhone with a rugged case but want to avoid common options like OtterBox or UAG, YETI's LoadOut lineup is worth a look. These cases pass MIL-STD-810H drop testing, offer reliable protection, support MagSafe, and include a built-in rotating kickstand for hands-free use.

Mous

If you're looking for a more premium yet not too thick case for iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, don't sleep on Mous. Now also offering a Cat with a Super Thin Aramid Fibre case for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max alongside the others featured below.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case $75
  • Mous Clear Case $70
  • Mous Limitless Aramid Fibre Case $85
  • Mous Thin MagSafe Case $55
  • Mous Thin Aramid Fibre Case $70
  • And more…

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro cases are more design-forward with a futuristic style, slim profile, and textured finishes that help them shine among your typical case options.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-Slim Aramid Fiber Case $66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop Protection Case $60 for iPhone 18 Pro
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case $40

Pitaka

If you're after a slimmer case for iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, PITAKA cases are for you. Their cases are usually lightweight Aramid Fiber with a clean, minimalist design while retaining MagSafe compatibility and added protection around the camera edges.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fibre Woven Case $60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-Grade Drop Protection Aramid Case $80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Case $60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro Series Cases

OtterBox also has a lineup of iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max cases ranging from slim everyday offerings to more rugged designs for when you need serious protection. Some of the newer models also support MagSafe, while select cases add features like grippy sides, accessory storage, raised camera protection, and built-in kickstands so you have options depending on how much thickness and protection you're willing to take on.

  • OtterBox Defender Series Pro $70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series $50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series Stand $60
  • OtterBox Sole Series $60
  • And more…

Belkin

If you want a cleaner and not-too-thick iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max case compared to a full-on rugged option, Belkin is a solid pick. Their lineup typically covers MagSafe-compatible clear and protective cases with raised edges around the display and camera, while select models like Protect+ add reinforced corners for a nice middle ground between everyday protection and slim design.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case $30
  • Belkin Qi2-Compatible MagSafe Grip Case $50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case with Airbag Corners $60

CASETiFY

CASETiFY is another brand that typically rolls out new iPhone cases quickly, and its iPhone 18 Pro lineup is already here with plenty of options. The brand is best known for colorful designs, bold prints, and protective cases that aren't overly utilitarian. You'll also find MagSafe support on most styles, as well as clear, impact-resistant, and more fashion-forward options.

  • CASETiFY Ripple Silicone Case $56
  • CASETiFY Impact Ring Stand Case $64
  • CASETiFY Mirror Case with MagSafe $64
  • And more…

Speck

Speck's iPhone 18 Pro lineup stays true to the brand's everyday protection style with clean designs. The lineup features plenty of slim, grippy cases along with MagSafe-supporting options and clear designs that let your phone color show through. These cases also offer solid drop protection without adding too much bulk.

  • Speck Presidio Clear Grip Case $50 for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max
  • Speck Presidio 2 Grip ClickLock Case with MagSafe $50
  • Speck CandyShell Icon Case with MagSafe $40
  • And more…

elago

elago cases lean toward clean, minimalist designs at a more affordable price than other options. The lineup typically includes slim silicone, clear, and MagSafe-compatible cases with plenty of simple colors to match Apple's devices.

  • elago Urban Clear Case $14 (Reg. $16)
  • elago Pebble Case $15 (Reg. $17)
  • elago Ring Stand Armor Case $19 (Reg. $25)
  • elago Ridge Silicone Case $19
  • And more…
